keyPoints.en: DRSABC: check Danger → Response → Send for help (999/112) → Airway (head tilt, chin lift) → Breathing (10 s) → Circulation.
keyPoints.bm: DRSABC: periksa Bahaya → Respons → Minta bantuan (999/112) → Saluran pernafasan (dongak kepala, angkat dagu) → Pernafasan (10 saat) → Peredaran.
Tidak sedar tetapi bernafas → kedudukan pemulihan.

keyPoints.en: Adult CPR: 30 compressions : 2 breaths, 100–120/min, about 5–6 cm deep, centre of chest. Use an AED if available.
keyPoints.bm: CPR dewasa: 30 tekanan : 2 hembusan, 100–120 seminit, sedalam kira-kira 5–6 cm, tengah dada. Gunakan AED jika ada.

keyPoints.en: Choking adult: up to 5 back blows, then up to 5 abdominal thrusts; repeat; call 999.
keyPoints.bm: Dewasa tercekik: hingga 5 tepukan belakang, kemudian hingga 5 tekanan abdomen; ulang; hubungi 999.

tip.en: Join a certified CPR course — practice on a manikin builds confidence.
tip.bm: Sertai kursus CPR bertauliah — latihan dengan patung membina keyakinan.

keyPoints.en: Sprain: RICE. Burn: cool running water ~20 min, no blister bursting. Nosebleed: lean forward, pinch nose.
keyPoints.bm: Terseliuh: RICE. Melecur: air sejuk mengalir ~20 minit, jangan pecahkan lepuh. Hidung berdarah: condong ke hadapan, picit hidung.

keyPoints.en: Always inform a teacher and seek medical help for serious injuries.
keyPoints.bm: Sentiasa maklumkan guru dan dapatkan rawatan untuk kecederaan serius.
